steps.name: 서식 줄 - 표: 글꼴·크기·＋행/－행/＋열/－열·머리 면·머리 글자·링크
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-sel="e01"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const F=document.querySelector('#ftb'); const has=(s)=>!!F.querySelector(s); const ops=F.querySelectorAll('[data-f="tblop"]').length; return F.classList.contains('show') && has('select[data-f="font"]') && has('[data-f="size"]') && ops===4 && has('[data-f="headFill"]') && has('[data-f="headColor"]') && has('[data-f="link"]') && !has('[data-f="rot"]') ? true : 'ops='+ops+' html='+F.innerHTML.slice(0,200)

steps.name: 서식 줄 ＋행 → 3×2 · Ctrl+Z
steps.js: document.querySelector('#ftb [data-f="tblop"][data-v="row+"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const n=document.querySelector('#ftb .pt[title="행 × 열"]').textContent; document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click(); await until(()=>n==='3×2', 3000); return n==='3×2' ? true : 'n='+n

steps.name: 서식 줄 - 글머리: 글꼴·크기·글자색·종류·점 색·간격·글자 상자로
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-sel="e02"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const F=document.querySelector('#ftb'); const has=(s)=>!!F.querySelector(s); return has('select[data-f="font"]') && has('[data-f="color"]') && has('[data-f="marker"]') && has('[data-f="dot"]') && has('[data-f="spacing"]') && has('[data-f="conv"][data-v="text"]') && !has('[data-f="bold"]') ? true : F.innerHTML.slice(0,300)

steps.name: 글머리 종류 메뉴 → ◆ 고르면 marker=◆
steps.js: document.querySelector('#ftb [data-f="marker"]').click(); const b=await until(()=>document.querySelector('#menu [data-mk="◆"]'), 3000); if(!b) return 'no menu'; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const t=document.querySelector('#ftb [data-f="marker"]').textContent.trim(); document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click(); await until(()=>t.startsWith('◆'), 3000); return t.startsWith('◆') ? true : 't='+t

steps.name: 간격 메뉴 → 항목 간격 28
steps.js: document.querySelector('#ftb [data-f="spacing"]').click(); const it=await until(()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('#menu button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='28'), 3000); if(!it) return 'no 28'; it.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const ok=document.querySelector('#tab-props input[data-k="gap"]'); const v=ok&&ok.value; document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click(); await until(()=>v==='28', 3000); return v==='28' ? true : 'gap='+v

steps.name: 서식 줄 - 그림: 투명도·자르기(켜짐)·바꾸기·링크·그림자·회전
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-sel="e05"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const F=document.querySelector('#ftb'); const has=(s)=>!!F.querySelector(s); const op=F.querySelector('[data-f="opacity"]'); return op && op.value==='50' && F.querySelector('[data-f="crop"]').classList.contains('on') && has('[data-f="imgpick"]') && has('[data-f="link"]') && has('[data-f="shadow"]') && has('[data-f="rot"]') && !has('[data-f="size"]') ? true : F.innerHTML.slice(0,300)

steps.name: 효과 선택 상자 → softEdge 고르면 mask CSS · 속성에 수준 세그
steps.js: const sel=document.querySelector('#ftb select[data-f="effect"]'); if(!sel) return 'no effect select'; sel.value='softEdge'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const fx=document.querySelector('#host .rs-el[data-id="e05"] .rs-fx'); const seg=document.querySelector('#tab-props .seg[data-k="effectLevel"]'); const ok=fx && /mask-image/.test(fx.getAttribute('style')) && seg; document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click(); await until(()=>ok, 3000); return ok ? true : 'fx='+(fx&&fx.getAttribute('style').slice(0,60))+' seg='+!!seg

steps.name: 투명도 80 입력 → opacity 0.8
steps.js: const op=document.querySelector('#ftb [data-f="opacity"]'); op.value='80'; op.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const v=document.querySelector('#tab-props [data-opacity]').value; document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click(); await until(()=>v==='80', 3000); return v==='80' ? true : 'v='+v

steps.name: 자르기 메뉴 → 왼쪽 10 적용 → crop[0]=0.1
steps.js: document.querySelector('#ftb [data-f="crop"]').click(); const i=await until(()=>document.querySelector('#menu [data-ci="0"]'), 3000); if(!i) return 'no menu'; i.value='10'; document.querySelector('#menu [data-capply]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const v=document.querySelector('#tab-props [data-crop="0"]').value; document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click(); await until(()=>v==='10', 3000); return v==='10' ? true : 'v='+v

steps.name: 서식 줄 - 상자: 링크 켜짐·그림자 켜짐 · 링크 메뉴에서 지우기
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-sel="e02"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const F=document.querySelector('#ftb'); const on=F.querySelector('[data-f="link"]').classList.contains('on') && F.querySelector('[data-f="shadow"]').classList.contains('on'); F.querySelector('[data-f="link"]').click(); const del=await until(()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('#menu button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('링크 지우기')), 3000); if(!del) return 'no del'; del.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const off=!document.querySelector('#ftb [data-f="link"]').classList.contains('on'); document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click(); await until(()=>on && off, 3000); return on && off ? true : 'on='+on+' off='+off

steps.name: 회전 메뉴 → 90° → rot=90
steps.js: document.querySelector('#ftb [data-f="rot"]').click(); const it=await until(()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('#menu button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='90°'), 3000); if(!it) return 'no 90'; it.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const v=document.querySelector('#tab-props input[data-k="rot"]').value; document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click(); await until(()=>v==='90', 3000); return v==='90' ? true : 'rot='+v

steps.name: 서식 줄 - 도형: 종류 선택 상자 → 바꾸면 shape 속성 변경
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-sel="e01"]').click(); const s=await until(()=>document.querySelector('#ftb select[data-f="shape"]'), 3000); if(!s) return 'no select'; const was=s.value; const other=[...s.options].find(o=>o.value!==was).value; s.value=other; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const v=document.querySelector('#tab-props select[data-k="shape"]').value; document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click(); await until(()=>v===other, 3000); return v===other ? true : 'v='+v+' want='+other
